title: Our God is an Awesome God
lyrics_original: When He rolls up His sleeves
He ain't just puttin' on the Ritz
There is thunder in His footsteps
And lightning in His fists
Well the Lord He wasn't jokin'
When He kicked 'em out of Eden
It wasn't for no reason that He shed His blood
His return is very close and so you better be believin'
That our God is an Awesome God
Our God is an Awesome God
He reigns from heaven above
With wisdom power and love
Our God is an Awesome God
When the sky was starless in the void of the night
He spoke into the darkness and created the light
Judgement and wrath He poured out the Sodom
Mercy and grace He gave us at the cross
I hope that we have not too quickly forgotten that
Our God is an Awesome God
Our God is an Awesome God
He reigns from heaven above
With wisdom power and love
Our God is an Awesome God (3)

bible_verses.telugu: తన పరిశుద్ధ స్థలములలో దేవుడు భీకరుడు ఇశ్రాయేలు దేవుడే తన ప్రజలకు బలపరాక్రమ ముల ననుగ్రహించుచున్నాడు దేవుడు స్తుతినొందును గాక.
bible_verses.english: You, God, are awesome in your sanctuary; the God of Israel gives power and strength to his people. Praise be to God!

bible_verses.telugu: నీ ఉరుముల ధ్వని సుడిగాలిలో మ్రోగెను మెరుపులు లోకమును ప్రకాశింపజేసెను భూమి వణకి కంపించెను.
bible_verses.english: Your thunder was heard in the whirlwind, your lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.

bible_verses.telugu: ఇదిగో త్వరగా వచ్చుచున్నాను. వానివాని క్రియచొప్పున ప్రతివాని కిచ్చుటకు నేను సిద్ధపరచిన జీతము నాయొద్ద ఉన్నది.
bible_verses.english: Look, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, and I will give to each person according to what they have done.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Almighty, You are truly an awesome God, filled with majesty, power, and boundless love. Thank You for making a way for us through Your precious blood and for guarding our lives with Your sovereign grace. Help me to walk faithfully today, keeping my eyes fixed on You and expecting Your glorious return. May my life bring honor to Your great Name. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When we reflect on the grandeur of our Creator, we are reminded that His supreme power is paired with an incredible love. From the thunderous majesty of creation to the tender sacrifice of the cross, God acts with purposeful grace. As we sing of His awesome nature, we are invited to bow our hearts in reverent awe and live with hopeful expectancy for His promised return. Let His holiness draw you closer to His loving heart today.
